Posture Program

Understanding recurring posture concerns through body alignment and pain patterns

Forward head posture, flat back and hip misalignment may also affect facial contours, shoulder or lower-back pain, and walking habits.

01

Forward head posture

We assess how tension around the neck and jaw affects facial contours and shoulder discomfort.

02

Flat back

We assess back movement and tension around the rib cage, considering breathing and postural balance together.

03

Hip misalignment

We consider left-to-right differences in the pelvis and hips in relation to lower-back tension, walking and changes in body shape.
